description: Change a form's name, status, questions, notifications, forwarding, close date, response limit or thank-you message. Only the fields you pass change; fields replaces the whole question list. Set status to archived to stop taking responses. After setting destinations.webhookUrl, call replo_forms_webhook_secret_rotate to get the signing secret. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

closesAt.description: When the form stops taking responses; null never closes

destinations.description: Replaces the forwarding settings; the webhook signing secret is kept. After setting webhookUrl, call replo_forms_webhook_secret_rotate to get the signing secret

fields.description: Replaces every question; the site shows the change at once

key.description: Stable identifier of the field within its form

showIf.description: Ask this question only after a matching answer; otherwise it is skipped, never required, and its answer is dropped

anyOf.description: Ask this question when the answer is one of these. Checkbox and consent answers compare as "true" or "false", numbers and ratings as their digits, and a pick-several answer matches when any choice is listed
